# Rudraansh Yatra — Full Knowledge Base for LLMs and AI Agents
> Complete textual documentation, expedition itineraries, altitude profiles, distance matrices, permit protocols, and company facts for Rudraansh Yatra (https://rudraanshyatra.com).

## Organization Overview
Rudraansh Yatra is a certified local ground tour operator and high-altitude expedition management company based in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, India. Founded in 2015 by native mountaineer Dheerendra Rautela (certified in Tour Manager Operations by the Tourism and Hospitality Skill Council - THSC), the organization specializes in direct, zero-outsourcing ground execution for spiritual pilgrimages and Himalayan adventure treks across the Kumaon region.

- Organization Type: LocalBusiness / TourOperator / TravelAgency
- Registered Name: Rudraansh Yatra
- Founder: Dheerendra Rautela
- Headquarters: 1st Floor Above Maniram Punetha & Sons, Simalgair Bazaar, Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand — 262501, India
- Geographic Coordinates: 29.5855307 N, 80.212559 E
- Primary Contact: +91 7617617651 / info@rudraanshyatra.com
- Official Website: https://rudraanshyatra.com
- MSME Registration: UDYAM-UK-09-0012985 (Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India)
- Ministry of Tourism NIDHI: EUK000357
- Customer Rating: 5.0 out of 5.0 stars from 39 verified Google Maps traveler reviews; TripAdvisor Traveller's Choice recipient

## Operational Model & Safety Standards
1. 100% Direct Ground Execution: All logistics—including vehicle dispatch, driver assignment, homestay booking, and permit clearance—are managed by in-house Pithoragarh staff. No bookings are resold to outside aggregators or third-party tour brokers.
2. Mountain Vehicle Fleet: Fleet consists exclusively of rugged 4x4 Mahindra Boleros driven by native Kumaoni high-altitude drivers trained in mountain driving, landslide crossing, and rapid tire changes.
3. Permit Processing: Physical and online liaison with the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) offices in Dharchula and Pithoragarh for Inner Line Permits (ILP), police verification processing, and medical check coordination.
4. High-Altitude Medical Preparedness: Every vehicle and expedition carries medical-grade portable oxygen cylinders, fingertip pulse oximeters, and mountain-specific first-aid kits. Direct emergency communication lines are maintained with ITBP (Indo-Tibetan Border Police) and local police stations.
5. Community Homestay Economics: Yatris are accommodated in authentic homestays run by indigenous Rung tribal families in Gunji, Nabi, Kuti, and Daktu villages, ensuring financial benefits flow directly into local border communities.

## Circuit 1: Adi Kailash & Om Parvat Yatra
- Primary URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/adi-kailash
- Region: Byas Valley, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand, India
- Sacred Highlights: Mount Adi Kailash (5,945 m / 19,505 ft), Parvati Sarovar (4,500 m / 14,764 ft), Gauri Kund (4,600 m / 15,092 ft), Om Parvat (5,590 m / 18,340 ft) with natural snow-embossed Om (ॐ) symbol, Sheshnag Parvat, Ved Vyas Gufa in Kalapani, and Kali Mata Temple (source of Kali River).
- Base Hubs: Dharchula (915 m), Gunji (3,200 m / 10,500 ft), Nabi (3,150 m), Kuti (3,750 m), Jyolingkong (4,300 m).
- Key Packages:
  - Ex-Pithoragarh: 3 Days / 2 Nights — ₹18,000 per person
  - Ex-Kathgodam: 6 Days / 5 Nights — ₹30,000 per person
  - Ex-Delhi: 6 Days / 5 Nights — ₹35,000 per person
- Permit Requirement: Inner Line Permit (ILP) issued by SDM Dharchula. Requires valid government photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID), Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) or valid passport, and physical fitness medical certificate signed by an MBBS doctor.
- Operating Seasons: May to June (Pre-Monsoon Spring/Summer) and September to early November (Post-Monsoon Autumn with crystal clear blue skies).

## Circuit 2: Darma Valley Exploration
- Primary URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/darma-valley
- Region: Darma Valley, Pithoragarh District, Uttarakhand
- Key Locations: Dharchula, Tawaghat, Sobla, Baun, Tidang, Go, Daktu village (3,100 m / 10,171 ft), Panchachuli Base Camp (3,475 m), Meola Glacier, Sona Glacier.
- Road Distances:
  - Dehradun to Darma Valley: ~475 km (16–18 hrs driving via Rishikesh, Almora, Pithoragarh, Dharchula). Recommended 2-day split journey.
  - Delhi to Darma Valley: ~550 km (18–20 hrs driving via Moradabad, Haldwani, Pithoragarh, Dharchula).
  - Pithoragarh to Darma Valley: 145 km (6–7 hrs: 80 km paved NH-9 to Dharchula + 65 km rugged 4x4 track to Daktu).
  - Dharchula to Daktu: 65 km along Dhauliganga gorge (3.5–4.5 hrs, strictly 4x4 Bolero).
- Daktu Village Profile: Altitude 3,100 m (10,171 ft). Principal settlement of Rung community known for carved wooden deodar houses, traditional wool weaving, and direct 4 km walking trail to Panchachuli Base Camp.
- Family & Child Suitability: Appropriate for children aged 8 and above and active senior citizens. Direct 4x4 motorable access to Daktu eliminates mandatory rigorous trekking.

## Circuit 3: Khaliya Top Alpine Trek
- Primary URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/khaliya-top
- Region: Munsiyari, Johar Valley, Pithoragarh District
- Altitude: Khaliya Top summit 3,500 m (11,500 ft); Zero Point 3,700 m (12,140 ft).
- Trek Profile: 4 Days / 3 Nights package from Munsiyari (₹9,500 per person). 6 km ascent through rhododendron, oak, and deodar forests starting from Balati Bend (2,250 m).
- Views: 360-degree panoramic sight of Panchachuli Peaks (I through V), Hardeol, Rajrambha, Nanda Kot, and Nanda Devi East.

## Circuit 4: Sacred Kumaon Temples
- Patal Bhuvaneshwar (https://rudraanshyatra.com/patal-bhuvaneshwar): Subterranean limestone cave complex in Gangolihat with stalactite and stalagmite formations depicting 33 crore Hindu deities.
- Jageshwar Dham (https://rudraanshyatra.com/jageshwar-dham): 8th-century sanctuary of 124 Jyotirlinga temples nestled amidst towering deodars.
- Chitai Golu Devta (https://rudraanshyatra.com/chitai-golu-devta): Deity of Supreme Justice in Almora, renowned for petition letters and thousands of copper bells.
- Kainchi Dham (https://rudraanshyatra.com/kainchi-dham): Spiritual ashram founded by Neem Karoli Baba.
